SELECT DISTINCT dd.fiscal_year, dd.calendar_year, MIN(dd.calendar_date) as min_date, MAX(dd.calendar_date) as max_date
FROM dim_date dd
GROUP BY dd.fiscal_year, dd.calendar_year
ORDER BY dd.fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 10

FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ds.region,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND fsl.channel_code = 'ST'
  AND ds.region NOT IN ('Head office', 'Online')
GROUP BY ds.region
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

SELECT DISTINCT dd.fiscal_year, fsl.channel_code, COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
GROUP BY dd.fiscal_year, fsl.channel_code
ORDER BY dd.fiscal_year DESC, fsl.channel_code

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ds.region,
  ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 2) as net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as receipts,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(fsl.net_amount) DESC) as rank
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND ds.store_id NOT IN (900, 999)
GROUP BY ds.region
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

SELECT MIN(fsl.sale_date) as earliest_sale, MAX(fsl.sale_date) as latest_sale
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
